ads.headline: No More Wincing At Cold.
ads.signType: a huge roadside BILLBOARD beside a busy city highway, shot from the road with traffic below and sky behind
ads.brief: Bright daylight, realistic highway with cars, the billboard dominant and crystal sharp. Small LACALUT Sensitive tube in the billboard bottom corner.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S1

ads.headline: WARNING: Cold Shouldn't Make You Wince.
ads.signType: a weathered yellow-and-black INDUSTRIAL WARNING / caution metal sign, distressed with rust and scratches, bolted to a wall
ads.brief: The word WARNING huge across the top in heavy black caps on yellow, the rest of the message below in bold black. Gritty realistic metal. Small LACALUT Sensitive tube at the bottom of the sign.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S2

ads.headline: For Teeth That Feel Every Sip.
ads.signType: a bright yellow POST-IT NOTE stuck on a bathroom mirror, handwritten in marker
ads.brief: Real bathroom mirror with soft reflection, morning light, the post-it in sharp focus with bold handwritten marker text. LACALUT Sensitive tube sitting small on the vanity.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S3

ads.headline: German Comfort For Sensitive Teeth.
ads.signType: a push NOTIFICATION banner popping up at the top of a phone lock screen, bold notification title text
ads.brief: Realistic phone lock screen held in hand, time and battery at top, the LACALUT notification banner bold and legible. A small LACALUT Sensitive tube on a surface behind the phone.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S4

ads.headline: Comfort In Every Sip.
ads.signType: bold lettering TATTOOED across the upper BACK of a person photographed from behind in a natural candid setting
ads.brief: Candid real photo from behind, natural skin and lighting, the tattoo text large, crisp and easy to read. LACALUT Sensitive tube resting small on a bench in the background.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S5

ads.headline: Sensitive? Sorted.
ads.signType: a few words written across the FOREHEAD of a person, candid close-up portrait in a real everyday setting
ads.brief: Candid close-up of a believable everyday Australian, slight smile, the forehead text bold and clearly legible. Hold the message very short so it fits large across the forehead.
ads.label: SENSITIVE SIGN S6
